metadata.title: AzureDevOpsDscNative
metadata.description: A fork of the DSC Community AzureDevOpsDsc module with native DSC v3 support: every resource is discoverable and invokable by dsc.exe via the Microsoft.Adapter/PowerShell adapter, using generated adapted resource manifests, without requiring a wrapper resource.
